key_findings: Salivary VEGF is increased in type 2 diabetic denture wearers and correlates positively with socket closure and negatively with pain at day 21.
Diabetic rats show a blunted palatal tissue VEGF response to injury; wounds under a palatal plate show higher tissue VEGF.
